name: Exo suit, full

how.jump_m: (your own jump work + leg drives' push work) / (total mass x g); push work per drive = min(peak torque x joint swing, a quarter of peak torque x top speed x push time) x efficiency
how.sprint_mps: your sprint x (1 + leg drive power / your sprint power) x body mass / total mass
how.lift_kg: two arms, crate held in front: the heaviest load with every motor within its continuous torque, no beam or strap failing and the wearer within their maximum
how.strength_lift_kg: the same with motors allowed up to their peak torque and the suit carrying the whole arm when that helps (Strength mode); without load-bearing gauntlets the arm straps' pressure usually sets the limit
how.break_kg: the load at which a beam's safety factor drops below 1 (the part breaks)
how.throw_j: your throw + both arms' drives (continuous torque x swing x efficiency); speed = sqrt(2 x energy / (object + arm mass))
how.hp: base 100 x (1 + 0.5 x shell protection per body area); protection = area x thickness x strength / 300 MPa
how.drain_w: sprint and speed from leg drive power, strength from arm drive power, armour per m2 of shell, cloak per m2 of body

note: Game rules fed by the physics core. The tester's numbers are the physics; these are for play.
